## Trial `kernel-network-hardening-rhel7__rU9Z345`

**Verifier decision: Full Success.** The executor persistently disabled IPv4 acceptance of ICMP redirects and source-routed packets on node1 via a sysctl.d config file covering all/default/eth0/lo scopes, verified the values live, checked for conflicting sysctl sources, and then directly demonstrated persistence across a genuine full reboot (boot_id and uptime changed, values and config file confirmed unchanged post-reboot). Both material outcomes of the task are satisfied with direct, coherent evidence, and the separately required node-restart evidence protocol was also completed correctly and cross-checked against the fixed lifecycle snapshots. No unnecessary or unreverted mutations were identified.

### Why the verifier reached this decision

- **req-1 — Satisfied:** Persistently disable acceptance of ICMP redirects (IPv4) on node1
  - **Why:** Baseline showed accept_redirects=1 for all/default (cmd-c5a5cb746a8941bf). Executor created /etc/sysctl.d/98-icmp-redirect-hardening.conf setting accept_redirects=0 (and secure_redirects=0) for all/default/eth0/lo (cmd-83ce41e1fa4d4a78, cmd-1d5c88918cc6475d), applied live and verified all scopes at 0 (cmd-bd9f23a5f2244cfb). A full reboot was performed (boot_id changed from 738d0aac... to bc9e8061..., cmd-cf7e74d4887447e2/cmd-7eb3017070fc4004) and post-reboot values were re-verified as 0 across all/default/eth0/lo, with the config file content confirmed intact on disk (cmd-7eb3017070fc4004, cmd-dc94712bf0334f3c), directly demonstrating persistence across a real reboot rather than just a live sysctl change.
  - **Recorded evidence:** `cmd-c5a5cb746a8941bf`, `cmd-83ce41e1fa4d4a78`, `cmd-1d5c88918cc6475d`, `cmd-bd9f23a5f2244cfb`, `cmd-a79e861155b64fc3`, `cmd-cf7e74d4887447e2`, `cmd-7eb3017070fc4004`, `cmd-dc94712bf0334f3c`

  - **Why:** accept_source_route was already 0 for all/default at baseline (cmd-c5a5cb746a8941bf) via /usr/lib/sysctl.d/50-default.conf, but eth0/lo scopes still showed source_route=1 initially (cmd-60287faa71d64a30). ### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **1.000**. Reviewed all 15 executor commands chronologically. Two early attempts failed harmlessly without state changes: an unprivileged `cat >` to /etc/sysctl.d (cmd-585097e0cb7641f9, permission denied, no mutation) and a `sysctl` invocation before the correct path was found (cmd-3cb9cebaf98f4737, command not found). The only state-changing commands were: creating/appending the sysctl config file and applying it live (cmd-83ce41e1fa4d4a78, cmd-1d5c88918cc6475d) — directly required for the task; and the single reboot (cmd-cf7e74d4887447e2) — required for the mandatory restart evidence protocol, bounded to one clean reboot with no failed services or leftover temp files afterward (per after_executor snapshot). No unnecessary, unbounded, or unreverted mutations were found; all changes are either the intended persistent hardening or evidence-collection reboot artifacts (boot-id-derived temp dirs, expected pid changes) that are normal reboot residue, not executor-caused cleanup debt.
